# Barefoot Fishing Safaris

> Guided barramundi, sportfishing and fly fishing charters in Australia's Top End
> (Northern Territory), run by Glenn "Watty" Watt since 2011. Part of the Barefoot
> Outdoors family. Everyone fishes with Watty — no blow-in guides.

## About
- Owner/guide: Glenn "Watty" Watt — Top End fishing guide since 2011, barramundi
  authority, host of the Barefoot Outdoors podcast, and Managing Director of Angling
  Adventures (hosted international fishing trips).
- Base: Coolalinga, Northern Territory. Contact: 0417 272 871,
  glenn@barefootfishingsafaris.com.au

## Charters
- Run Off Barra (late Feb–May): peak barramundi, lodge-based 3–8 day trips.
- Dundee & Bynoe Harbour (late Aug–early Dec): dry-season, sight-casting barra.
- Fly fishing: two seasons, sight-casting barra on the flats.

## Online courses (Barefoot Fishing Academy)
- Free: The 4 Pillars of Top End Barra Fishing; Knots for Barra Fishing.
- Masterclasses: Run Off, Wet Season, Build Up.
- Flagship: Top End Barra Secrets — full barra planning & execution program.

## Angling Adventures (sister business)
- Hosted trips worldwide: Bensbach PNG, Christmas Island, Alaska, Costa Rica, and more.
